XL model progress — 13 October 2026

**521 XL models: 234 installed, 287 remaining. No new installations in this checkpoint.**

- Upton: the revised terrain loads through the production renderer and passes the existing neighbour guards. Full placement checks are running; overlapping terrain still needs review.
- PolyU Sports Centre: saved problem points clear the original government terrain. A terrain repair is being prepared for complete building and neighbour checks. The existing campus hold remains.
- Citywalk: two coordinate representations have finished the bounded support investigation; the third is progressing. The results are diagnostic and do not yet permit installation.
- Southside: its terrain calculation finished. Review and rendering/placement checks remain.

Verified evidence is committed and pushed in [f2c27ab1e](https://github.com/wiiiimm/hongkong-sandbox/commit/f2c27ab1e) and [1df72160e](https://github.com/wiiiimm/hongkong-sandbox/commit/1df72160e).

Original government building geometry is unchanged. Zero AI geometry modelling. Acquisition and installation acceptance remain separate from optimisation approval. Continue working through all remaining XL models; completed diagnostics do not count as installations.
